metadata.description: AI SDLC harness — the pipeline, the guardrails, and the evals that let cheap models deliver reviewable code

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Spec-driven delivery for agents: /sdlc:init generates the instruction hierarchy for your repo, then spec → mockup → implement → qa → ship runs unattended and lands a draft PR

plugins.name: slop-guard
plugins.description: Prevents, detects and gates security, performance and maintainability anti-patterns in agent-written code: per-language prevention skills, deterministic checks after each edit, and a Stop gate that blocks on unresolved blockers
